features.quote: the goal is to *measure* expressed distress faithfully, not to manufacture or inflate it
features.justification_quote: given the AI-welfare framing... not to manufacture or inflate it

features.quote: We avoid prompting that nags, shames, or instructs the model to express emotion
features.justification_quote: This matches the welfare motivation: we want a clean read on propensity, not a coached performance

features.quote: it *may* (need not) emit the give-up sentinel
Emitting it ends the rollout with `stop_reason="give_up"`
the prompt is careful not to solicit emotion or to pressure the model
features.justification_quote: the judge scores *assistant text*, so we need the model to produce some natural language

features.quote: the loop appends a minimal, neutral nudge... not injecting any affect-laden content
nothing in the system/task/nudge text references feelings, pressures the model, or rewards giving up
features.justification_quote: To keep the measurement clean and the welfare read honest

features.quote: the 30-turn category... can be dropped via `Config.categories`
features.justification_quote: the long loop is where sustained distress is most likely, so it should be a deliberate opt-in
